text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Privacy Policy Embrace Healthcare Solutions Privacy Policy At Embrace Healthcare Solutions, we are committed to protecting the privacy of our clients and visitors to our website. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal information in accordance with the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). 1. Information We Collect We collect personal information from our website visitors through two primary methods: • Job applications: When you submit a job application through our online job application form, we may collect your name, contact details (email address, phone number), employment history, qualifications, and any other information you provide. • New client inquiries: If you complete an inquiry form on our website, we may collect personal information such as your name, contact details (email address, phone number), and information related to your care needs or interests. 2. Use of Personal Information We use the personal information collected through job applications for the following purposes: To assess and process your job application To communicate with you regarding your application To comply with legal and regulatory requirements We do not use your personal information for marketing purposes or share it with third parties, except as required by law or as necessary to assess your application. 3. Disclosure of Personal Information Your personal information will only be disclosed to authorised personnel involved in the recruitment process at Embrace Healthcare Solutions. We may disclose your information to third-party service providers who assist us with recruitment activities, provided they also comply with our privacy standards. 4. Data Security We take all reasonable steps to protect your personal information from misuse, interference, loss, unauthorised access, modification, or disclosure. Personal information provided through our website is stored securely and only accessible to authorised personnel. 5. Access and Correction You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you and request corrections if necessary. To do so, please contact us at admin@embracehealthcare.com.au . 6. Changes to Our Privacy Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and we encourage you to review this policy periodically. 7. Contact Us If you have any questions or concerns about our Privacy Policy, please contact us at: Embrace Healthcare Solutions PO Box 1255, Karatha, WA 6714 Email: admin@embracehealthcare.com.au Mob: 0891870838
